newsitem.title: USA: Energy BioSystems granted four patents.
newsitem.headline: Energy BioSystems granted four patents.

text.p: Energy BioSystems Corp said on Wednesday that it was granted four U.S. patents relating its biocatalytic desulfurization (BDS) process to help fossil-fuel refiners meet environmental regulations.

Energy BioSystems said biocatalytic desulfurization is the use of bacteria to remove sulfur from petroleum. The process could improve the value of high-sulfur crude oil reserves and provide cleaner burning fossil fuels.

With the issuance of the four new patents, Energy BioSystems has rights to 19 U.S. patents and 23 foreign patents. It also has 11 patent applications pending in the U.S. and more than 106 foreign patent applications pending for its technology and the cloning of biocatalyst genes.
The four patents are expected to improve the economics and the efficacy of bio-desulfurization, the company said.
